posts.title: Marathon (Closed Alpha)
posts.description: It’s probably a good sign that I can’t stop thinking about Marathon . Bungie, no matter how much its upper management seems intent on death spiraling the company , is unrivaled at creating games with that certain spark that eludes everyone else. You could try and pair it down to their strength in art design or their best-in-class gunplay but there’s a sort of sum-of-its-parts element to their work
